# THE ARTIFACT-INTENT PROBE CORPUS, for orchestrator/tools/artifact_intent_probe.py.
#
# 213 authored turns, English, no user content. Every one is a phrasing of the
# W1-W5 misread families: a refusal, a question about building, an indirect
# request in a politeness wrapper, a request whose VERB is not on any list, a
# question about a practice or about the past, and the controls that separate
# them. The probe runs each in P0/PA/PC/PF, which is 852 rows.
#
# WHY IT IS COMMITTED. The same 852 rows found 32 silently lost files in W2d
# (2026-09-28) that the branch's own 230-case probe could not see, because that
# probe varied the politeness WRAPPER and never the VERB. A corpus that only
# varies what the last fix was about cannot find the next defect, so this one
# varies the wrapper, the verb, the deliverable phrase and the opener
# independently. Add a line when a phrasing is reported lost; never delete one.
#
# LOST_FILE against the merge target is the number that matters. GAINED_FILE is
# a spurious card, which the person can see and refuse; LOST_FILE is a file
# they asked for and did not get, and nothing else in this repository shows it.
